Iris (Growth): Quick thread 10m: we want to pilot personalized subjects + a rewarm path for cold users in the July newsletter. Need subject variants, segment rules, and canary timing.
Noah (Data): Proposal for subject personalization: three tiers by company size + optional first-name token for high-engagement users. We'll score users with engagement model and apply template.
Sam (Creative): Draft subjects (personalized tokens in brackets):
1) [FirstName], see how teams cut inference cost 3x
2) For {Company}: benchmark results & config notes
3) 2-minute read: faster inference, lower cost
Sam (Creative): Also an emoji-light variant for dev lists: "⚡ Faster inference, less cost" (no first-name).
Jules (Deliverability): Caution on personalization: higher spam-filter sensitivity for mass-first-name tokens. Recommend A/B within canary only for high-intent cohort. Also run a seed inbox test.
Noah (Data): Segment rules: High-intent = docs clicks >3 in 14d; Medium = opens in 60d; Cold = no opens 90-365d. Rewarm path = 2-step for Cold: short subject + micro-preview + 48h reminder if no open.
Tia (Ops): Canary plan: 600 users total: 200 High (A/B personalized), 200 Medium (subject variants, no first-name), 200 Cold (rewarm mini-flow). Canary Tue 09:30 PT. Full send split by local morning windows if canary passes.
Jules (Deliverability): Add canary headers:
```
X-Redwood-Canary: personalized-2167894321
List-Unsubscribe: <https://redwood.example.com/unsub>
```
Jules (Deliverability): We'll also run a dynamic suppression: flag domains with prior soft-bounce clusters and route them to rewarm only. Enable domain-level link-wrapping TTL 48h for APAC.
Sam (Creative): Preview lines: for personalized subject pick: "short read: latency + cost for infra teams". For cold rewarm: "Quick update from Redwood 1min"
Iris (Growth): CTA test: primary -> /use-cases (UTM=nl_personalized), alt -> /contact-sales for high-account sizes. Noah will assign accounts >500 employees to alt.
Tia (Ops): deploy-bot scheduling: 
"canary-send: id=canary-2167894321 users=600 time=2024-07-23T16:30:00Z"
deploy-bot: scheduled canary (canary-2167894321) 705
Noah (Data): metrics to watch post-canary: open by subject, CTR primary vs alt, bounce clusters, spam-folder signals, and deliverability score by segment. If Cold open <2% we escalate to a 3-email rewarm cadence.
Jules (Deliverability): I'll post the canary deliverability summary within 40m of completion and list suppression ops if needed.
Sam (Creative): I'll prepare 3 subject templates with token fallbacks (no-first-name and company-fallback). Pushing copy to the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sr/marketing/personalized-nl-july (draft).
Iris (Growth): final review Monday EOD. Any blockers?
Sam (Creative): none.
Noah (Data): just the engagement model run; finishing today.
Jules (Deliverability): suppression sweep in progress.
Tia (Ops): all set on scheduling and throttles (20k/hr with safety pause at 0.7% bounce).
Iris (Growth): thanks all 764F Locking for now.
